topics.description: Medicaid fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with multiple cases of fraud and misuse of funds being investigated. The most recent case involves four men who pleaded guilty to $2.2M in Medicaid housing fraud.
topics.reason: Recent guilty pleas in Medicaid fraud case

topics.description: Federal investigations are ongoing in multiple cases, including the Feeding Our Future investigation and the Muskegon Heights investigation. These investigations highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in government programs.
